sentences.text: Bench: Pamidighantam Sri Narasimha, Pankaj Mithal  IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA

CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION  CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 2900 OF 2024  (Arising out of S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 1892 of 2024)
 SANKALP NAIDU ... APPE  VS.
 THE STATE OF CHHATTISGARH ... RESP  O R D E R 1.
Leave granted.

2. This appeal by way of Special Leave Petition is against the order passed by the High Court of Chhattisgarh in MCRC No. 6075 of 2023 dated 15.12.2023 by which the High Court rejected the bail application filed by the appellant herein.

3. Heard learned counsel for the appellant as also the counsel appearing for the State of Chhattisgarh.
4.

The appellant is charged for the offences under Sections 363, 366 and 376 of IPC and Section 4 &
6 of the POCSO Act, 2012.
His bail application was initially rejected by the Trial Court and High Court on 04.05.2023 and 22.06.2023 and finally by the impugned order of the High Court on 15.12.2023.
5. It is evident from the record that the chargesheet has been filed and in fact the prosecutrix was examined on 04.08.2023.
We are also informed that eleven out of fifteen Reason: witnesses have been examined.
In the facts and circumstances of the case, we are of the considered opinion that this is a fit case for grant of bail.

6. The appellant shall be released on bail in connection with FIR No. 201 of 2023 registered at P.S.
Kota, District Bilaspur subject to such terms and conditions as may be imposed by the Trial Court.
7. In view of above, the appeal is disposed of.
J. [PAMIDIGHANTAM SRI NARASIMHA]

J. [PANKAJ MITHAL] NEW DELHI;
